# BEA error contract

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate.mjs. Do not edit; run `npm run generate` (drift fails `npm run check`). -->

Every failed tool call returns `isError: true` with one text item whose content is `{"error": projection}` and no
`structuredContent`. The projection is closed: the codes and categories below are the only ones BEA emits. JSON
Schema: [error-contract.schema.json](error-contract.schema.json). `details.effects_applied` is always present and
lists target changes made before the failure.

## Codes

| Code                          | Category              | Error tags                                     |
| ----------------------------- | --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `invalid_request`             | `invalid_input`       | `InputError`                                   |
| `configuration_invalid`       | `invalid_input`       | `ConfigurationError`                           |
| `session_not_found`           | `invalid_input`       | `SessionNotFound`                              |
| `reference_not_found`         | `invalid_input`       | `ReferenceNotFound`                            |
| `invalid_state`               | `target_state`        | `InvalidState`                                 |
| `target_exited`               | `target_state`        | `TargetExited`                                 |
| `instance_mismatch`           | `target_state`        | `InstanceMismatch`                             |
| `address_unmapped`            | `target_state`        | `AddressUnmapped`                              |
| `memory_access_failed`        | `target_state`        | `MemoryAccessFailed`                           |
| `instrumentation_failed`      | `execution_failure`   | `InstrumentationFailed`                        |
| `effect_unreverted`           | `target_state`        | `EffectUnreverted`                             |
| `access_denied`               | `unavailable`         | `AccessDenied`                                 |
| `unsupported_target`          | `unsupported`         | `UnsupportedTarget`                            |
| `capability_unavailable`      | `unavailable`         | `CapabilityUnavailable`, `GateDisabled`        |
| `provider_timeout`            | `timeout`             | `ProviderTimeout`                              |
| `cancelled`                   | `cancelled`           | `Cancelled`                                    |
| `resource_constraint`         | `resource_constraint` | `ResourceConstraint`                           |
| `evidence_integrity_mismatch` | `integrity_mismatch`  | `EvidenceIntegrity`                            |
| `revision_conflict`           | `integrity_mismatch`  | `RevisionConflict`                             |
| `file_operation_failed`       | `execution_failure`   | `FileOperationFailed`                          |
| `cleanup_incomplete`          | `execution_failure`   | projection override when cleanup is incomplete |
| `execution_failure`           | `execution_failure`   | `ProviderFailure`, `Internal`                  |

Categories: `invalid_input`, `target_state`, `unsupported`, `unavailable`, `timeout`, `cancelled`, `resource_constraint`, `integrity_mismatch`, `execution_failure`.

## One example per tag

### `InputError` → `invalid_request`

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_request",
    "category": "invalid_input",
    "message": "The read_memory arguments are invalid (1 issue).",
    "retryable": false,
    "remediation": {
      "action": "Correct the fields listed in details.issues using the tool's input schema, then retry. Do not repeat the unchanged call."
    },
    "recovery": {
      "kind": "inspect_input_contract",
      "operation": "read_memory"
    },
    "details": {
      "issues": [
        {
          "path": "size",
          "reason": "out_of_range",
          "message": "Too big",
          "maximum": 65536
        }
      ],
      "effects_applied": []
    }
  }
}
```

```json
      },
      "detach_reason": "process-terminated",

      "instance_id": "pi_aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
    }
  }
}
```
